title: AgenticOCR: Parsing Only What You Need for Efficient Retrieval-Augmented Generation
selection_reason: AgenticOCR performs query-driven, on-demand visual-region parsing instead of sending full pages to the generator; the abstract says this reduces extraneous context and improves visual-RAG efficiency, directly lowering model-side input burden.
